expo.name: Move Campus Driver
expo.description: Android driver prototype for consent-based campus trip location sharing.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow Move Campus Driver to use your location while you are on an active trip.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow Move Campus Driver to share your location during an active trip, including when the app is in the background.
plugins.locationAlwaysPermission: Allow Move Campus Driver to share your location during an active trip, including when the app is in the background.
